title: Ended my loyalty to Pelonis
text:
Ended my loyalty to Pelonis. I do not understand all the positive remarks about this heater. I have been a Pelonis fan for years, I have 3 fans by them and I Thought I could buy with confidence because of the brand. I was stunned to find out I was wrong.
This is Not a Heater. It barely pushes a very small amount of heat that you have to be so close to feel that, if you thought to use it while sleeping, would have to be at a distance of less than 36 inches sooo...not going to win any awards for safety here.

Now the non heated fan works just fine, to be fair and objective. Not a thing wrong with that aspect.
But the rest of it's performance has ensured that I will never look for a Pelonis product with the certainty of a reliable purchase again.
This is basically junk in a box.
